description: This file defines the DoubleRange class, which models a bounded or unbounded numeric range with comparison and containment logic, used within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: DoubleRange
classes.description: Represents a numeric range with optional bounds, including methods for comparison, containment, and string representation.

methods.name: DoubleRange
methods.description: Constructs a DoubleRange with optional low and high bounds, defaulting to negative and positive infinity respectively if null.

methods.name: getHigh
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the range.

methods.name: setHigh
methods.description: Sets the upper bound of the range, defaulting to positive infinity if null.

methods.name: getLow
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the range.

methods.name: setLow
methods.description: Sets the lower bound of the range, defaulting to negative infinity if null.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this range with another based on their low and high bounds.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks whether a given double value falls within this range.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the range, indicating bounds.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality between this range and another object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the range bounds.
